de.short: Die State-Struktur gehört zur VideoRecordingStateResponse, der Tabellentext bezeichnet sie aber als Request-Daten für PauseRecordingRRM.
de.long: VRS-011 ist ein bestätigter Copy/Paste-Rollenfehler in der offiziellen V2.4-Dokumentation. Die Tabelle beschreibt die neu eingeführte VideoRecordingStateStructure innerhalb der korrigierten GetVideoRecordingState-Response-Modellierung. en.title: VideoRecordingService V2.4: VideoRecordingStateStructure is incorrectly described as a PauseRecordingRRM request
en.short: The state structure belongs to VideoRecordingStateResponse, but the table text labels it as request data for PauseRecordingRRM.
en.long: VRS-011 is a confirmed copy-paste role defect in the official V2.4 documentation. The table describes the newly introduced VideoRecordingStateStructure within the corrected GetVideoRecordingState response model. Its descriptive cell, however, says it is the request data structure for PauseRecordingRRM. This contradicts the surrounding section; the PR #27 candidate XSD independently confirms the state-response role without becoming official XSD authority.
en.recommendation: Ignore the incorrect role description and treat the state structure only as part of VideoRecordingStateResponse. Do not derive any additional PauseRecordingRRM structure or alias relationship from that table text.
